1.arihu*ra-mu*mi-mu.
2.sorekosoha,Yi inoYu Di nonaiQi Dian dearu. sonoZhong niha,Zhu woWei reruZhe tachihenoDao kigaaru.
3.Zhu woWei reruZhe tachitoha,You Xuan Jie woXin zi,Li Bai noWu mewoShou ri,matawaregaShou ketamonowoShi suZhe,
4.matawaregaanata(muhanmado)niQi Shi shitamono,mataanataYi Qian (noYu Yan Zhe tachi)niQi Shi shitamonowoXin zi,mataLai Shi woJian kuXin ziruZhe tachidearu.
5.koreranoZhe ha,Zhu karaDao karetaZhe deari,mataZhi Shang noXing Fu woCheng Jiu suruZhe dearu.
6.Ben Dang niXin Yang woJu Fou suruZhe ha,anatagaJing Gao shitemo,mataJing Gao shinakutemoTong zide,(Wan Gu ni)Xin ziyoutohashinaidearou.
7.atsura-ha,kareranoXin moEr womoFeng zirareru. mataMu nihaFu iwosare,Zhong iCheng Fa woKe serareyou.
8.mataRen bitonoZhong,[watashitachihaatsura-woXin zi,Zui Hou no(Shen Pan no)Ri woXin ziru. ] toYan uZhe gaaru. dagakarerahaXin Zhe dehanai.
9.karerahaatsura-toXin Yang suruZhe tachiwo,Qi koutoshiteiru. (Shi Ji ha)Zi Fen woQi iteirunoniGuo ginainodaga,kareraha(soreni)Qi Fu kanai.
10.kareranoXin nihaBing gaSu tsuteiru. atsura-ha,sonoBing woZhong kusuru. konoWei rinotameni,kareranihaShou Tong iCheng Fa gaXia sareyou.
11.[anatagataha,Di Shang woTui Fei sasetehanaranai. ] toYan wareruto,kareraha,[watashitachihaJiao Zheng surudakenomonodearu. ] toYan u.
12.iya,Ben Dang nikarerakoso,Tui Fei woYin kiQi kosuZhe dearu. dagakareraha(soreni)Qi Fu kanai.

13.[Ren bitogaXin Yang suruyou,Xin Yang shinasai. ] toYan wareruto,kareraha,[watashitachihaYu kaZhe gaXin Yang suruyouni,Xin zirareyouka. ] toYan u. iya,Ben Dang nikarerakosoYu kaZhe dearu. dagakareraha,(sorega)Fen ranai.

14.karerahaXin Yang suruZhe niHui eba,[watashitachihaXin Yang suru. ] toYan u. dagakareragaZhong Jian noE Mo [shiyaita-n] tachidakeninaruto,[Ben Dang haanatagatatoYi Xu nanoda. watashitachiha,Zhi (Xin Zhe tachiwo)Yu Nong shiteitadakeda. ] toYan u.
15.dagaatsura-ha,konoyounaLian Zhong woYu Nong shi,Bu Xin Xin nomamaniFang Zhi shi,Dang temonakusaMi waserareru.
16.koreranoZhe haDao kinoDai warini,Mi iwoGou tsutaZhe de,kareranoQu Yin haLi Yi naku,mataJue shiteZheng shikuDao karenai.
17.karerawoPi erebaHuo woDeng suZhe noyoude,Zhe Jiao Huo gaBian riwoZhao rashitanoni,atsura-hakareranoGuang woQu riShang gerare,An An noZhong niQu riCan saretanode,He Yi tsuJian rukotogaChu Lai nai.
18.Long Ya deMang Ren nanode,karerahaYin kiFan sukotomoChu Lai naidearou.

19.mata(Pi eba)An An noZhong deLei Ming toDao Qi woBan nauHao Yu gaTian karaJiang tsutekitayounamonode,Luo Lei noKong sakaraSi woKong rete,(Xi rani)Er niZhi woChai shiIp mu. dagaatsura-ha,Bu Xin Xin Zhe tachiwoQuan Bu Qu riWei mareru.

20.Dao Qi hahotondokareranoShi Jue woDuo wanbakaridearu. Shan kuDu nisonoZhong deBu miwoJin meruga,An An ninarebaLi chiZhi maru. moshimoatsura-gaYu Wang minaraba,kareranoTing Jue moShi Jue moBi zuQu riShang gerareru. Ben Dang niatsura-ha,Fan tenokotoniQuan Neng dearareru.
21.Ren bitoyo. anatagata,mataanatagataYi Qian noZhe woChuang raretaZhu niShi enasai. Kong rakuanatagataha(E Mo niDui shi)sonoShen woShou rudearou.

22.(kareha)anatagatanotameniDa Di woWo Suo toshi,mataDa Kong woTian Gai tosare,Tian karaYu woJiang rase,anatagatanotameniLiang toshiteZhong "noGuo Shi woShi raserareruFang dearu. dakaraanatagataha(Zhen Li wo)Zhi tsutaShang ha,(Wei Yi naru)atsura-noWai niTong ziyounaShen gaarunadotoChang etehanaranai.

23.moshianatagataga,wagashimobe(muhanmado)niXia shitaQi Shi woYi unaraba,soreniLei suru1Zhang [su-ra] demoZuo tsuteminasai. moshianatagatagaZheng shikereba,atsura-Yi Wai noanatagatanoZheng Ren woHu ndeminasai.
24.moshianatagatagaChu Lai nainaraba,iya,Chu Lai ruhazumonainodaga,sorenaraba,Ren Jian toShi woRan Liao tosuruDi Yu noYe Huo woKong renasai. sorehaBu Xin Xin Zhe notameniYong Yi sareteiru.

25.Xin Yang shiteShan Xing niQin shimuZhe tachiniha,kareranotameni,Chuan gaXia woLiu reruLe Yuan niJiu itenoJi Bao woChuan enasai. karerahasokode,Liang noGuo Shi woYu erareruDu ni,[korehawatashitachigaYi Qian niYu eraretaWu da. ] toYan u. kareraniha,soreCheng Si tamonogaShou kerareru. mataChun Jie naPei Ou Zhe woShou kerare,Yong Yuan nisonoZhong niZhu munodearu.

26.Ben Dang niatsura-ha,Wen matahaGeng niXiao saimonowomo,Bi Yu niJu gerukotowoYan warenai. Xin Yang suruZhe hasoregaZhu karaXia saretaZhen Li dearukotowoZhi ru. dagaBu Xin Xin Zhe ha,[atsura-ha,konoBi Yu deYi Ti He woYu Wang midarou. ] toYan u. kareha,konoyouniDuo kunoZhe woMi uniRen se,mataDuo kunoZhe wo(Zheng shiiDao ni)Dao kareru. kareha,Zhu noZheng niBei kuZhe noWai ha,(Shui mo)Mi wasanai.
27.Que Yue shiteZhi kinagaraatsura-tonoYue Shu woPo ruZhe,atsura-gaJie petoMing ziraretamonokaraLi re,Di Shang deE woXing uZhe,koreranoZhe ha(Deng shiku)Shi Bai Zhe dearu.

28.anatagatahadoushiteatsura-woJu Fou Chu Lai youka. karekosohaSheng Ming nonaianatagatani,Sheng Ming woShou keraretaYu Fang. sorekaraanatagatawoSi nase,Geng niSu rase,Geng nimatakarenoYu Xu niGui raserareruYu Fang.
29.karekosoha,anatagatanotameni,Di Shang noFan tenomonowoChuang raretaFang deari,Geng niTian noChuang Zao niXiang kai,7tsunoTian woWan Cheng saretaYu Fang. matakarehaFan tenokotowoShou Zhi sareru.

30.mataanatanoZhu ga(Xian ni)Tian Shi tachiniXiang katsute,[Ben Dang niwareha,Di Shang niDai Li Zhe woZhi kudearou. ] toYang seraretaShi woSi iQi se. karerahaShen shiShang geta. [anatahaDi Shang deE woXing i,Xie woLiu suZhe woZhi karerunodesuka. watashitachiha,anatawoZan eteChang Nian shi,mataanatanoShen Sheng woRang Mei shiteimasunoni. ] karehaYang serareta. [Ben Dang niwarehaanatagatagaZhi ranaikotowoZhi tsuteiru. ]
31.karehaa-damuniFan tenomononoMing woJiao e,Ci nisorerawoTian Shi tachiniShi sare,[moshi,anatagata(noYan Xie )gaZhen Shi nara,koreranomononoMing wowareniYan tsuteminasai. ] toYang serareta.

32.kareraha(Da ete)Shen shiShang geta. [anatanoRong Guang woZan emasu. anataga,watashitachiniJiao eraretamononoWai niha,He moZhi ranainodesu. Ben Dang nianataha,Quan Zhi nishiteYing Ming deararemasu. ]

33.karehaYang serareta. [a-damuyo,soreranoMing wokarera(Tian Shi )niGao geyo. ] sokodea-damugasoreranoMing wokareraniGao geruto,kareha,[warehaTian toDi noAo Yi woZhi tsuteirutoanatagataniGao getadehanaika. anatagatagaXian wasukotomo,Yin sukotomoZhi tsuteiru. ] toYang serareta.

34.matawaregaTian Shi tachini,[anatagata,a-damunisazidashinasai. ] toYan tsutaShi woSi iQi se. sonoShi,Jie sazidashitaga,E Mo [iburi-su] dakehaCheng Zhi sezu,korewoJu Fou shitanode,Gao Man deBu Xin noTu tonatsuta.
35.warehaYan tsuta. [a-damuyo,anatatoanatanoQi tohakonoYuan niZhu mi,He Chu demoWang muSuo de,Si uCun Fen Shi benasai. daga,konoMu niJin Fu itehanaranai. Bu Yi woDong kuZhe tonarudearoukara. ]

36.tokorogaE Mo [shiyaita-n] ha,2Ren woZhi kase,kareragaZhi kareteita(Xing Fu na)Chang Suo karaLi resaseta. wareha,[anatagatahaLuo chiteXing ke. anatagataha,Hu iniDi dearu. Di Shang niha,anatagatanotameniZhu maito,Jia Chu noSheng Huo noSheng Ji gaarou. ] toYan tsuta.
37.sonoHou,a-damuha,Zhu karaYu Yan Xie woShou kari,Zhu hakarenoHui Wu woXu sareta. Ben Dang nikareha,Kuan Da niXu sareruCi Bei Shen iYu Fang dearareru.
38.warehaYan tsuta. [anatagatahaJie kokokaraLuo chiteXing ke. yagateanatagataniBi zuwarenoDao kigaHui mareyou. soshitewarenoDao kiniCong uZhe ha,Kong remonakuYou imonaidearou.
39.dagaXin Yang woJu Fou shi,warenoYin woXu Hu bawarisuruZhe ha,Ye Huo noZhu Ren deatsute,Yong Yuan nisonoZhong niZhu mudearou. ]
40.isuraerunoZi Sun tachiyo,anatagataniShi shitawarenoEn Hui woXin niMing Ji shi,waretonoYue Shu woLu Xing shinasai. warehaanatagatatonoYue Shu woGuo sudearou. waredakewoWei renasai.

41.anatagatagaChi tsuteirumononoQue Zheng toshite,waregaXia shitaQi Shi (kurua-n)woXin zi,korewoXin zinaiZhe no,Xian Tou ninatsutehanaranai. mataJin kanaDai Chang de,wagaYin woMai tsutehanaranai. soshitewaredakewoWei renasai.
42.Xu womotsuteZhen Li woBei tsutari,mata(Que kani)Zhi tsuteinagara,Zhen Li woYin shitehanaranai.
43.Li Bai [sara-to)noWu mewoShou ri,Ding menoShi shi[zaka--Bu ] wonashi,Li Li [ruku-u] niQin shimuRen tachitoGong niLi Li shinasai.
44.anatagataha,Ren bitoniShan Xing woQuan menagara,Zi Fen deha(sonoShi Xing wo)Wang reteshimatsutanoka. anatagatahaQi Dian woDu Song shinagara,soredemoShang Li Jie shinainoka.

47.isuraerunoZi Sun tachiyo,waregaanatagataniYu etaEn Hui to,(wagaQi Shi wo)Mo Min niXian nzi(teXia shi)takotowoNian iQi se.

48.soshiteShui moWai noZhe notameniShen Dai rininarenaiRi notameni,matadonnaZhi riCheng shimoXu sarezu,Chang imoShou keRu rerarezu,mataShui Yi Ren Zhu kerukotonoChu Lai nai(Ri notameni)sonoShen woShou rinasai.

52.soredemo,sonoHou warehaanatagatawoXu shita. Bi zuanatagatahaGan Xie surudearou.

[watashinoMin yo,Ben Dang nianatagataha,Zi Niu woXuan nde,Zi rawoZui niXian reta. dakaraanatagatanoChuang Zao noZhu noYu Xu niHui Wu shiteGui ri,anatagataZi Shen woSha shinasai. soushitara,Chuang Zao noZhu noYu Mu nimoXie i,anatagatanotamenimoyoidarou. ] koushitekareha,anatagatanoHui Wu woShou keRu rerareta. 57.warehaYun noYing woanatagatanoShang niSong ri,soshitemannatouzuratowoXia shi,[waregaShou keruShan imonowoShi benasai. ] (toGao getaga,iukotowokikanakatsuta). karerahawarewoSun natsutanodehanaku,Zhi Zi Fen noHun woSun natsutanodearu.

58.matakouYan tsutaShi woSi iQi se. [anatagataha,konoTing niRu ri,Yi nomamanisokodeCun Fen niShi benasai. Tou woDi kushiteMen woRu ri,{Yu Xu shiXia sai. } toYan e. warehaanatagatanoGuo chiwoShe shi,mataShan Xing wosuruZhe niha(Bao Jiang wo)Zeng sudearou. ]

(sorenara)anatagatanoWang mumonogaQiu merareruyouna,donoTing nidemoJiang riteXing kugayoi. ] koushitekareraha,Qu Ru toPin Kun niuchihishigare,mataatsura-noJi Nu woBei mutsuta. sorehakareraga,atsura-noYin woJu Fou shiteXin zinaide,Bu Dang nimoYu Yan Zhe tachiwoSha Hai shitatamedearu. koremokareragaatsura-noZheng niBei ite,Zui woFan shiteitatamedearu.

65.mataanatagataha,Zi Fen tachinoZhong deAn Xi Ri noZheng woPo tsutaZhe niJiu iteZhi tsuteiru,warehakareraniYan iDu shita. [anatagatahaYuan ninare,Bei merarePai Chi sareyo. ]
